# Architecture Briefs

Settled design decisions produced by the harness Architect stage.

Each Brief represents a **decision already made**. Agents follow settled decisions or explicitly
challenge them via the Feedback stage — they do not silently re-litigate them.

## Format

```markdown
# Brief: <short decision title>

**Status:** Settled | Superseded | Draft  
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD  
**Stage:** Architect

## Decision

One paragraph: what was decided and why.

## Constraints

Bullet list of invariants this decision imposes on implementation.

## Alternatives Considered

What was rejected and why (prevents future agents from re-opening closed questions).

## Review Gate

What would constitute a valid reason to challenge this via the Feedback stage.
```
